meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取 screenpipe 在你电脑上记录的屏幕操作历史，找出重复出现的工作流程，和已有技能比对，为没覆盖到的流程起草新技能或组合配方，生成提案文件供你审阅和启用。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近一段时间（如几小时、一天、一周）的工作并提议新技能，或问哪些工作还没被现有技能覆盖时触发。需要本机 screenpipe 服务在运行。

say.text: 分析我最近一周的工作，提出几个新技能建议。
say.note: 会启动分析流程，生成提案文件夹。

say.text: 看看我常用的操作里有什么重复模式，哪些技能还没覆盖。
say.note: 会先做本地归类，再给出匹配结果。

say.text: 根据我最近的工作流，起草一个组合方案或新技能。
say.note: 会生成 SKILL.md 草稿供你审阅。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your screen history captured by screenpipe, detects repeated workflows, matches them against existing skills, and drafts new skills or recipes for uncovered patterns, outputting proposals for review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze your recent work (e.g., last hours, day, week) and propose new skills, or to find what isn't covered yet. Requires a running local screenpipe daemon.

say_en.text: Analyze my last week of work and propose a few new skills.
say_en.note: Runs the analysis pipeline and writes a proposal folder.

say_en.text: Look at my repeated actions and tell me which skills aren't covering them.
Draft a new skill or composition recipe from my recent workflow.
say_en.note: Generates a SKILL.md draft for review.
